notes.title: Even smaller patch
notes.content:
Hello hello!

Just a small update to the demo fixing a few things:
- input prompts for controllers displaying correctly now
- boss music sometimes playing when reentering boss room when boss is defeated fixed
- death screen text fixed
- fixes for getting out of bounds (hopefully!)

That's all for this patch, and likely for this early demo. We have moved to working on the full game now, but we still appreciate any bug reports sent through as we will need to address them in the full game. Eventually this demo will no longer reflect the quality of the full game and will be removed from Steam. We will give notice prior for this of course. We hope to release another demo when we are close to launch!

Thank you all for your support so far! It's time to make a game. If you'd like to support the project, late pledges are enabled on the Kickstarter page.

Thanks!
Dan

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
Hey all!
Just a quick update to the demo to fix a few bugs. Additionally, attaching to a climbable wall should now be more reliable.

Fixes:
- Pausing after quitting fixed
- Pausing on end of demo screen disabled
- Dodgeroll out of bounds upon entering a room vertically fixed
- Infinite healing bug fixed
- Pausing when landing on drop platforms breaking them fixed

That's all for this update! If you'd like to support the project, late pledges are enabled on our past Kickstarter campaign. A huge thank you to everyone who helped us smash over 150% of our target!

Thanks,
Dan

notes.title: Small patch + Kickstarter is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just updated the demo fixing a few things including:
- vigour earring no longer gives an extra heart every time you die
- opening the map or pausing during a screen transition fixed
- coin pickup sound is now tied to the sound volume slider
- dying while a lever door is opening no longer breaks that door forever, it will be open next time you reach that room
- vertical inputs are now prioritised while airborne, making pogoing and attaching to climbable walls more consistent (for controller users who prefer left-stick over d-pad)
- pressing Q on keyboard no longer changes controls
- a small increase to i-frames after taking damage

In exciting news, the Kickstarter campaign has entered its second week and we're over 85% of the way there! If you'd like to help us get over the line and maybe even reach a stretch goal or two, you can check out the campaign here.
A very special thank you to everyone who has backed the Kickstarter already!

And thank you to everyone who has player the demo so far, to everyone who has wishlisted, and to those that have left feedback. The response to Pipsqueak! has been incredible so far and we are truly grateful!

All the best,
Dan
